subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should outbound delivery adopt operation-capable same-id plugin precedence while QQBot reconnect recovery bypasses normal backoff for the selected connection and outbound-resolution errors?
rationale: Tests establish mechanical correctness, but cross-plugin precedence and reconnect retry timing are compatibility and delivery policies that require owner intent.

options.title: Accept both policies
options.body: Land the operation-aware resolver and QQBot reconnect drain as written after a refreshed exact-head check.

options.title: Narrow immediate retries
options.body: Keep the resolver and reconnect drain but replace the broad backoff-bypass matcher with a named, narrower set of proven pre-connect QQBot failures.

options.title: Split resolver and replay
options.body: Land the generic resolver separately and hold QQBot queue replay until its retry policy has dedicated owner approval.

recommendation.title: Accept both policies
recommendation.body: Land the operation-aware resolver and QQBot reconnect drain as written after a refreshed exact-head check.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history covers all three decision surfaces: outbound resolution, gateway send, and delivery recovery.
